Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then the assembly raised their voices, and they wept in that night.
translations.2: And the congregation of the sons of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and said to them: 'Would that we had died in the land of Egypt — or would that we had died in this wilderness!'
translations.3: 'And why would God bring us into that land, that we should fall by the sword, so that our wives and our children become spoil? Is it not better for us to return to Egypt?'
translations.4: Then some of them said to one another: 'Let us appoint a head, and return to Egypt.'
translations.5: And Moses and Aaron fell upon their faces before the assembly of the congregation of the sons of Israel.
translations.6: And Joshua son of Nun, and Caleb son of Jephunneh — among those who had scouted the land — tore their garments.
translations.7: And they said to the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying: 'The land which we passed through to seek it out — it is a very, very good land.'
translations.8: 'If God has a will toward us, He will bring us into it and give it to us as a gift — a land flowing with milk and honey.'
translations.9: 'Only do not grumble against God, and do not fear the people of the land, for they are our food; their shadow has already departed from them. And God is with us — do not fear them.'
translations.10: Then nearly all the people were about to stone the two of them. Then the light of God appeared in the Tent of Meeting before all the sons of Israel.
translations.11: And God said to Moses: 'How long shall these people defy Me, and how long will they not believe in Me, despite all the signs which I performed among them?'
translations.12: 'They deserve that I strike them with pestilence and wear them down, and make of you a nation more numerous and mightier than they.'
translations.13: And Moses said to God: 'Yet the Egyptians will hear — You who brought these people up from among them by Your power —'
translations.14: 'and they will tell, together with the inhabitants of this land who have heard that You are God: Your light is among these people, seen eye to eye; and Your clouds rest upon them; and in a pillar of cloud You go before them by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.'
translations.15: 'And if You slay them all as one man, then all the nations who have heard these reports of You will say:'
translations.16: 'It was because the Lord was unable to bring these people into the land which He had promised them — so He slew them in the wilderness.'
translations.17: 'And now, let the greatness of Your power be made manifest, O Lord, as You spoke to me.'
translations.18: 'That You are God — long in forbearance, abounding in grace, forgiving iniquity together with transgression — and acquits, yet does not wholly acquit — visiting the iniquities of the fathers upon the sons, and upon the third and upon the fourth generation.'
translations.19: 'Pardon the iniquity of these people according to the abundance of Your grace, and as You have borne with them from Egypt until now.'
translations.20: And God said: 'I have pardoned them from immediate punishment, as you have said.'
translations.21: 'Yet — by My eternal existence, and by My light which fills all the world —'
translations.22: 'Surely all the men who saw My generosity and My signs which I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness, and who tested Me now this tenth time, and did not accept My command —'
translations.23: 'they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers; and likewise every one who defies Me shall not see it.'
translations.24: 'But My servant Caleb — as recompense for his having held a different view, following obedience to Me thereby — him I will bring into the land which he reached, and for his offspring he shall pass it on as an inheritance.'
translations.25: 'And now, the Amalekites and the Canaanites are dwelling in the valley. Turn back tomorrow and set out into the wilderness by the way of the Sea of Qulzum.'
translations.26: Then God spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
translations.27: 'How long shall I leave this wicked congregation, which has incited the nation against Me? I have indeed heard the grumbling of the sons of Israel, who grumbled against Me.'
translations.28: 'Say to them: By My eternal existence — says God — if I do not deal with you as you have said in My presence!'
translations.29: 'In this wilderness shall your bodies fall — from every one counted and numbered among you, from twenty years of age and upward — even as you grumbled against Me.'
translations.30: 'You shall not enter the land concerning which I swore by My word to settle you in it — except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.'
translations.31: 'And your children, whom you said would become spoil — them I will bring in, so that they may know the excellence of the land which you have despised.'
translations.32: 'But your bodies — you yourselves — shall fall in this wilderness.'
translations.33: 'And your sons shall remain wandering in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear the burden of your rebellion — until the perishing of your bodies therein.'
translations.34: 'By the count of the days in which you sought out the land — forty days, a year for each day — you shall bear your burdens for a full forty years, and you shall come to know the consequence of My displeasure.'
translations.35: 'I, God, have spoken this and I will do it — against all this wicked congregation, gathered against Me: in this wilderness they shall perish by death.'
translations.36: And the men whom Moses had sent to seek out the land — who returned and incited the congregation against him, and spread a reproach upon the land —
translations.37: those men died by a blow before God.
translations.38: But Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh lived, from among the men who had gone to seek out the land.
translations.39: And when Moses spoke these words to the congregation of the sons of Israel, the people grieved greatly.
translations.40: And they rose early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, and said: 'Here we are, and we will go up to the place which God commanded us — for we have indeed sinned.'
translations.41: Moses said to them: 'O people, do not transgress the command of God — for it will not succeed.'
translations.42: 'Do not go up — for the light of God is not with you — lest you be struck down before your enemies.'
translations.43: 'For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you will fall by the sword — because you have turned back from obedience to God, and God will not be with you.'
translations.44: Yet they acted presumptuously and went up to the top of the mountain; but the ark of the covenant of God and Moses did not stir from the midst of the camp.
translations.45: And the Amalekites and the Canaanites who dwelt in that mountain came down, and struck them and shattered them as far as Hormah.
